title: Sanitizer Is Final Stage After Math Typesetting
description: The frontend module shall apply the HTML sanitizer as the last step after math typesetting in the section-render pipeline.
rationale: KaTeX and Asciidoctor can introduce attribute injections or malformed markup when processing adversarial or malformed input. Sanitizing before typesetting would leave any XSS payload introduced by the math renderer unstripped; the sanitizer must be the final gate to close that window.
